alt: 騎車送貨的人沿山路前進，路上接連遇到倒樹、斷橋和落石，只得繞路前往遠處房屋。
scene_prompt: A single winding hillside delivery journey with the same cyclist and basket visible at the foreground and a visually continuous path: the route first detours around a fallen tree, then around a washed-out small bridge, then around a road blocked by a rockfall, finally reaches a small house in far right distance. One cyclist only, tracks and the winding path explain repeated setbacks. No arrows or text.
